caption:
Cincinnati’s Mya Perry (@myawittamac) has quietly established herself as one of the most reliable scoring guards in the Big 12.

She’s opened the season averaging 18.3 points, showing a willingness to take on defensive pressure while carrying a heavy offensive load.

Against Iowa State, Perry delivered a statement performance 26 points on 10-of-14 shooting, knocking down 4 threes and playing all 40 minutes in a key win. Her efficiency and shot-making late were the difference.

Perry continues to set the tone for Cincinnati, combining confidence, pace control, and shot creation from the guard spot.

When guards can score it efficiently and handle volume, defenses start adjusting.
Those are the ones you build around.
